name: What primary factors drive the cost of a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What primary factors drive the cost of a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends heavily on whether you keep your existing footprint or relocate appliances and sinks. Moving a sink or gas range requires rerouting plumbing lines and electrical circuits through floors or walls, which increases labor and trade coordination costs. Other major cost drivers include cabinet grade—such as stock versus custom-built finish carpentry—countertop selections like natural marble versus engineered surfaces, and the complexity of tile backsplashes. Choosing standard cabinet sizes and keeping fixtures in place significantly cuts expenses, whereas structural wall removal and custom tile work increase the overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on cabinet selections, countertop materials, tile work, and whether moving plumbing or electrical fixtures requires altering the existing floor plan.
